title: Per-address blacklist, blacklisted(address)
detects: A third spelling of the blacklist getter, common on launchpad-era tokens. Same capability as freeze-blacklist: an individual holder can be blocked from transacting.
knownFalseNegative: Any fourth spelling is invisible to all three blacklist patterns and left to the gap scan, which lists the common write functions (setBlacklisted, blacklistAddress, setBots).

coversExamples.observed: blacklisted(0x0) answers, the mechanism is present; setBlacklisted(address,bool) is in the bytecode and owner() answers a live address

rationale: In a sample of 40 actively traded tokens launched in the 90 days before 2026-09-06, this was the one token with a live owner and a blacklist, and the dictionary read its freeze authority as absent with no gap reported. The two existing spellings miss it.
